messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

The messaging app needs both "storage" and "sms" permissions to send MMS messages. Please use the `grant_app_permission(app_name="messaging", permission="storage")` tool on your phone to grant storage access first.

Once that's done, then use the `grant_app_permission(app_name="messaging", permission="sms")` tool to grant SMS permission.

Let me know once you've granted both permissions, and then we'll test if MMS is working.

I have granted the messaging app both "storage" and "sms" permissions. The status bar still shows excellent 5G signal and data enabled. Should I test now if I can send an MMS message?

Please complete the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
